skill.name: product-strategist
skill.description: Generates draft OKR cascades from company strategy to product and team levels, with alignment scores and dashboard output.
skill.summary: Create linked company, product, and team OKRs from five strategy templates.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: The sole static finding is a false positive. SKILL.md line 22 uses Markdown backticks to format a documented Python command, without executing it.

finding_verdicts.reason: The flagged text is an inline Markdown usage example for invoking the included Python script. It does not contain Ruby backtick syntax or execute a command.

content.value_statement: Strategy often loses clarity as goals move from company leaders to delivery teams. This skill creates linked OKR drafts and alignment scores across organizational levels.
actual_capabilities: Generates three company objectives with measurable key results from five strategy templates.
Cascades company OKRs into linked product objectives and key results.
Creates team-level OKRs for Growth, Platform, Mobile, and Data teams.
Tracks parent objectives and contribution relationships across each organizational level.
Calculates vertical alignment, horizontal alignment, coverage, balance, and an overall score.
Prints a readable dashboard and can optionally print the full cascade as JSON.
limitations: The command uses fixed sample metrics and does not accept custom metric values.
Strategy templates and team names are hardcoded in the Python script.
Target allocations and alignment scores use simple assumptions, not historical performance data.
The script prints results to standard output and does not save or synchronize them.

use_cases.title: Draft Quarterly Product OKRs
use_cases.description: Create an initial cascade from company strategy to product objectives and team commitments.

use_cases.title: Review Goal Alignment
use_cases.description: Inspect parent links, coverage, balance, and alignment scores before quarterly planning.

use_cases.title: Translate Product Goals
use_cases.description: Turn product objectives into draft key results for Growth, Platform, Mobile, and Data teams.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Basic Cascade
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate an OKR cascade using the [growth, retention, revenue, innovation, or operational] strategy. Summarize the company, product, and team objectives.
prompt_templates.scenario: Start a quarterly planning discussion with a structured draft.

prompt_templates.title: Explain Goal Relationships
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a [strategy] cascade. Explain how each product objective supports its company parent and how each team objective supports product goals.
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare an alignment review for product leaders and team leads.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate Alignment Quality
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a [strategy] cascade and review its alignment scores. Identify weak coverage, uneven team balance, and assumptions requiring leadership validation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Challenge a draft before committing teams to quarterly targets.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt the Cascade Model
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the generated [strategy] cascade for [business context]. Propose specific template, metric, allocation, and team-mapping changes while preserving parent links.
prompt_templates.scenario: Customize the fixed model for a different organization or operating model.

output_examples.input: Generate a retention OKR cascade and summarize the first company objective.
output: Company objective: Create lasting customer value and loyalty.
Key results address retention, product satisfaction, and churn.
The product objective converts the company goal into sticky user experiences.

output_examples.input: Generate the default growth cascade and report its alignment scores.
Show how a growth objective reaches product and team levels.
output_examples.output: The company acquisition objective becomes a product objective for viral features. Growth and Platform teams receive linked objectives with assigned key results.

best_practices: Replace sample metrics with validated baselines and targets before approving any generated OKR.
Review parent links with company leaders, product managers, and accountable team owners.
Treat alignment scores as discussion prompts and verify the assumptions behind each calculation.
anti_patterns: Do not publish generated OKRs without confirming owners, baselines, targets, and time periods.
Do not treat the fixed team mapping as an accurate representation of every organization.
Do not use the overall alignment score as the only measure of strategy quality.

faq.question: Which strategies are supported?
faq.answer: The generator supports growth, retention, revenue, innovation, and operational strategies.

faq.question: Can I provide custom metrics from the command line?
faq.answer: No. The current command uses fixed sample metrics defined inside the script.

faq.question: Which organizational levels are generated?
faq.answer: It generates company, product, and team levels with parent objective links.

faq.question: Which teams are included?
faq.answer: The script includes Growth, Platform, Mobile, and Data teams.

faq.question: How are alignment scores calculated?
faq.answer: The script combines vertical alignment, horizontal alignment, coverage, and balance using fixed weights.

faq.question: Does the skill save or sync results?
faq.answer: No. It prints a dashboard and optional JSON output to standard output.
